content.short: Swop.fi is a leading decentralized exchange and automated market maker built on the Waves blockchain.
content.description: Swop.fi is a premier automated market maker (AMM) and decentralized finance platform natively designed for the Waves ecosystem. It provides users with a high-speed and cost-effective environment for swapping digital assets, providing liquidity, and earning rewards through innovative farming programs. Swop.fi leverages Waves' unique infrastructure to ensure near-instant transaction finality and minimal slippage, even during periods of high network activity. The platform features an intuitive interface designed for both desktop and mobile users, making decentralized trading accessible to all. As a critical piece of Waves' infrastructure, Swop.fi drives liquidity and capital efficiency for the entire network.
content.meta: Swop.fi is the leading DEX and liquidity hub on Waves, offering high-speed swaps and yield-generating opportunities for decentralized assets.
